definitions.explanation: A chronic neurological disorder in which abnormal electrical activity in the brain causes recurring seizures. Usually written in kana, though the kanji {癲癇|てんかん} also exists.

examples.japanese: てんかん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発作|ほっさ}→発作：15023_hossa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
てんかん⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発作|ほっさ}→発作：15023_hossa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えられる→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: With epilepsy, seizures can be controlled with medication.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧てんかん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧し、⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧な⟦{通院|つういん}→通院：05975_tsuuin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}めた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor diagnosed epilepsy and recommended regular hospital visits.

notes:
A medical term for the seizure disorder. Normally written in hiragana in everyday text; the kanji {癲癇|てんかん} is rare and considered difficult.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- てんかん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発作|ほっさ}→発作：15023_hossa⟧: an epileptic seizure
- てんかん⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{患|わずら}う→患う：27883_wazurau⟧: to suffer from epilepsy
- てんかん{薬|やく}: anti-epileptic medication

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発作|ほっさ}→発作：15023_hossa⟧: a fit, attack, seizure — a single episode, not the disorder itself
- ⟦{痙攣|けいれん}→痙攣：06301_keiren⟧: convulsion, cramp — the muscle spasms that can occur during a seizure
